subject: SIG / SDLC evidence: PR logs, merge gate audit, secrets sampling, emergency change runbook
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@veridianhealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike D'Angelo <mike.da@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0400
Subject: SIG / SDLC evidence: PR logs, merge gate audit, secrets sampling, emergency change runbook

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the quick walkthrough last week. As part of the SIG assessment to complete our vendor security review, the assessor has asked us for a compact package of Secure SDLC evidence. We want to be efficient and only request what is necessary. Please provide the following artifacts (or links to where they can be retrieved):

- PR & code review trace for a recent production change (example: PR IDs, author, reviewers, merged timestamp, and short diff).
- Merge gate / deploy gating audit for the last quarter (CSV or export of who approved falls back to what policy).
- CI/CD pipeline config showing gated checks and OIDC/workflow that prevents secret leaks (high-level YAML and any console export of passed checks).
- Evidence of ephemeral secrets sampling (a short spreadsheet or log snippet showing rotation frequency and sampled key IDs).
- Emergency change runbook + approval trail for a recent hotfix (including rollback steps).

If you can put the items in a single ZIP or shared drive folder and share the link, that works. Ideally we get this by EOD Tuesday 2026-07-14 so the assessor can complete their review on schedule.

I've attached a brief request PDF to show the assessor's preferred formats. If any item is sensitive, please flag it and we can arrange an encrypted transfer or redaction.

Best,
Sara Holt
Senior Security Analyst
Veridian Health

Attachment: veridian_sig_request-20260712.pdf

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Sara Holt <sara.holt@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG / SDLC evidence: PR logs, merge gate audit, secrets sampling, emergency change runbook

Folks — forwarding an evidence ask from Veridian. Target: EOD Tue 2026-07-14. Minimal scope but needs clear provenance. Can we split the ask: 

- Marissa: PR/code-review trace + diff for a recent production change (pick a safe non-PII example). Include PR IDs, author, reviewers, merge commit and CI build id.
- Grace: Merge gate / deploy-gating audit (export for Q2 2026) + the CI job YAML that enforces gating.
- Jordan: Ephemeral secrets sampling spreadsheet and the emergency change runbook (we have v2 in Drive — any recent hotfix chronology would be helpful).

If anything is restricted, mark it and we will set up an encrypted Dropbox/Share link. I'll collate and provide a single Drive folder and give the external team view-only access.

Please respond with ETA in next 90 minutes so I can acknowledge Sara.

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Director, Platform Security & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -04:00

> Thanks again for the quick walkthrough last week...

Avery — I can take the PR trace. I pulled the following example change (safe to share redacted diff): PR #4537 (service-authentication):
- Author: nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com
- Reviewers: marissa_cole, grace_oconnor
- Merged: 2026-06-21T11:24:03Z
- CI Build ID: build-heritage-2026-06-21-1143 (artifact available)

Attached: pr-4537-diff.patch (redacted), and a short CSV export with the PR timeline. I also included a short text snippet from the merge commit message and the Gerrit/GitHub audit line.

Grace — pinging you for the merge-gate export and the gated job YAML. Jordan, can you attach the sampling spreadsheet and the runbook (or link if the runbook contains sensitive server names)?

I'll upload these to a view-only Drive folder once we have Jordan's pieces.

Attachments: pr-4537-diff.patch, pr-4537-timeline.csv

Marissa Cole
Senior Engineer, Release Reliability
Redwood Inference

Avery / team — thanks. I uploaded the remaining artifacts to the shared folder and redacted hostnames where required.

Link (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QwX-example-docs

Files added: merge-gate-audit-202606-quarter.csv, ephemeral-secrets-sampling.xlsx (sampling rows 5–10 shown, rotation IDs redacted), emergency-change-runbook-v2.pdf.

Sara — let us know if the current exports satisfy the assessor or if you'd like a signed log extract from our KMS team.

Jordan Blake
Manager, Build & Release Engineering
Redwood Inference
